name: Regulation of synapse assembly and synaptic protein localization
rationale: All members are positive or negative regulators of synapse and presynapse assembly or protein recruitment to synapses, whereas the confusables hold the concrete trans-synaptic adhesion and receptor-clustering machinery (neurexins, PSD-95, NMDA/GABA receptor clustering).

qualifier: Na+/K+-ATPase pumping and paracellular tight-junction transport
name: Na+/K+-ATPase cation homeostasis and paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: Members concern Na+, K+ and Mg2+ homeostasis via P-type ATPase gradients (incl. glycoside response) and tight-junction paracellular transport, which the confusables lack in favour of chloride cotransporters, aquaporin/vasopressin water handling or K+ channels.

name: G1/S transition control by RB-E2F and G1 CDKs
rationale: All members describe the G1/S switch: RB/DREAM repression of E2F targets, cyclin D/CDK4-6 and cyclin E/CDK2 activity, p27/p21 degradation, distinguishing it from confusables centred on replication origin licensing or G2/M progression.

qualifier: adrenal and gonadal, with its regulation
name: Adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis and its regulation
rationale: Members cover synthesis and control of pregnenolone, gluco-/mineralocorticoids, androgens and estrogens and their CYP enzyme defects, unlike confusables about vitamin D/retinoid metabolism or cortisol secretion and response.

qualifier: proline and glycine carriers defective in iminoglycinuria
name: Proline and glycine transmembrane transport and iminoglycinuria
rationale: All members concern proton-coupled/SLC6A20 transport of proline and glycine and its iminoglycinuria defects, whereas confusables cover cystine, organic ion, Hartnup or cationic amino acid transport.

name: Regulation of ER calcium release and cytosolic calcium clearance
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor release of sequestered ER calcium and its removal from the cytosol (Na+/Ca2+ exchange, ER re-uptake), distinguishing it from cardiac-specific, SERCA-only or store-operated calcium entry confusables.

name: Rab/ARF-regulated synaptic vesicle and receptor trafficking
rationale: Members span presynaptic vesicle cycling and postsynaptic receptor trafficking together with Rab/ARF GTPase signalling and RabGAPs, which the clathrin-endocytosis and receptor-recycling confusables lack.

name: Matrix metalloproteinase-mediated collagen degradation
rationale: All three members concern MMP activation and collagen catabolism, unlike confusables on ECM assembly, integrin interactions or fibrinolysis.

name: Secretory pathway trafficking through ER, Golgi and endosomes
rationale: Members cover ER targeting and export, COPI/COPII and intra-Golgi traffic, Golgi organization, endosome-Golgi retrograde routes and their Rab/ARF regulators, distinct from autophagy, ESCRT/MVB and unfolded protein response confusables.

name: Dopamine receptor signaling and drug reward behavior
rationale: Members combine dopamine receptor/DARPP-32 signalling with reward-related behaviours to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine and opioids, distinguishing it from neuropeptide, dopamine synthesis/transport, social behaviour and ethanol confusables.

qualifier: via ascorbate, NADPH and reactive species detoxification
name: Redox homeostasis via ascorbate, NADPH and reactive species detoxification
rationale: Members address ROS, aldehyde and methylglyoxal detoxification supported by ascorbate, NADPH/NADP+ and BH4 metabolism, whereas confusables centre on glutathione synthesis, ferroptosis promotion or alkylation DNA repair.

name: CaMK-CREB synapse-to-nucleus signaling in memory
rationale: Members link postsynaptic calcium/CaMKIV phosphorylation of CREB and NPAS4 transcription to long-term memory, distinguishing it from MECP2 regulation and cAMP/PKA-driven CREB confusables.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and promoter escape
rationale: All members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter opening and escape, preceding the elongation, pausing and NER steps held by the confusables.

name: Cranial and peripheral nerve development and axon guidance
rationale: Members cover axon guidance and migration of cranial, peripheral ganglion and monoaminergic neurons, unlike confusables on hindbrain patterning, enteric nervous system or semaphorin/netrin guidance signalling.

name: TLR-driven TAK1/IKK activation of canonical NF-kappaB
rationale: Members describe TRIF/IRAK/TRAF6/RIP1-mediated TAK1 and IKK activation leading to canonical NF-kappaB, distinguishing it from non-canonical NF-kappaB and TBK1-IRF3/7 or TLR3 cell-death confusables.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
name: 3'UTR-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members involve RNA-binding proteins (TTP, HuR, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1, IGF2BPs, L13a) that stabilise, destabilise or silence mRNAs via 3'UTR elements, unlike confusables on decapping/exonucleolytic decay, stress granules or miRNA silencing.
